hook.text: 42州总检察长阻止Character.AI拍卖用户聊天

summary.sub: 一条破产拍卖、一条开发工具、一条出口管制。每条都对过一手原文和独立媒体，原文没写的地方文中直接说明。

items.t: 42州总检察长介入Character.AI破产程序，反对把用户聊天记录和个人数据随资产拍卖，拍卖定在12月1日
Anthropic推出Claude Ship测试版，在GitHub上自动审查、修复PR，并按团队规则批准常规改动
美国商务部把Megaspeed列入实体清单，司法部调查其是否把Nvidia芯片违规运往中国

title.text: 42州总检察长阻止Character.AI拍卖用户聊天

oneline.text: 破产资产里包括用户聊天和个人数据，其中210多万账号登记为未成年人。

bullets.v: Character.AI 10月申请破产，聊天记录随资产定于12月1日拍卖，各州请求法院驳回出售条款。
公司曾承诺不出售用户数据，各州认为破产不能用来绕开这类消费者保护。
做AI聊天产品，隐私政策要写清公司被收购或破产时数据怎么处理。

sourceEvidence.quote: joined a bipartisan coalition of 42 attorneys general in opposing Character.AI’s plan to sell its platform

sourceEvidence.claim: 超过210万账号登记为未成年人
sourceEvidence.quote: more than 2.1 million of them registered to minors
are set to be sold at auction on December 1, 2026
Only one anonymous bidder for the chat data has been disclosed so far: Smirks and Pangs Acquisition LLC (Smirks)
Character.ai, which filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in October

oneline.text: 三个agent：审查、修复、按规则批准，面向GitHub仓库。

bullets.v: Claude Ship面向Team和Enterprise计划；Code Review已正式可用，PR Steward和Claude Approvals是测试版。
批准规则写成仓库里的策略文件，Claude可按规则自己批准常规改动。
按token计费，先用只观察模式跑一段，再决定是否接进分支保护。

sourceEvidence.claim: 审查、修复并按团队策略判断能否合并
sourceEvidence.quote: It can review PRs, fix them, and decide what's ready to merge based on policies each team sets.
Claude Ship is available on Claude Team and Enterprise plans for repositories on GitHub.
Code Review is generally available, and PR Steward and Claude Approvals are in beta.
Claude Ship usage is billed on tokens, so turning it on can add to an organization's costs.

sourceEvidence.claim: 审查、修复、按团队规则批准
sourceEvidence.quote: Claude Ship can review proposed code changes, fix problems, and approve changes permitted by a team's rules.

oneline.text: 司法部调查其是否把Nvidia芯片运往中国，新加坡执法部门参与过核查。

bullets.v: 商务部把Megaspeed列入实体清单，同批共7家实体，来自新加坡、马来西亚和泰国。
这是黄仁勋风波的核心公司；司法部称调查针对潜在出口管制违规。
在东南亚采购GPU算力的团队，要核对供应商是否在清单上。

sourceEvidence.quote: the Department of Commerce initiated an investigation into Megaspeed in 2024 for potential export control violations.
In June 2025, Nvidia placed Megaspeed on its “no sell” list.
The Commerce Department placed Megaspeed on the Entity List.
seven total entities were added to the list from Singapore, Malaysia, and Thailand

sourceEvidence.claim: 司法部长暗示Nvidia不是调查对象
sourceEvidence.quote: U.S. Attorney General Todd Blanche has suggested Nvidia isn't a target of an investigation
